L105@P5: 5. Appearance
L106@P5: There shall be no such defects as scratch, rust, discoloration, leakage which may adversely
L107@P5: affect commercial value of the cell.
L108@P5: 6. Standard Test Conditions
L109@P5: 6.1 Environmental Conditions
L110@P5: Unless otherwise specified, all tests stated in this specification are
L111@P5: conducted at temperature 23±3°(@RT)and humidity under 65%.
L112@P5: 6.2 Measuring Equipment
L113@P5: (1) Amp-meter and Volt-meter
L114@P5: The amp-meter and volt-meter should have an accuracy of the grade 0.5mA and
L115@P5: mV or higher.
L116@P5: (2) Slide caliper
L117@P5: The slide caliper should have 0.01 mm scale.
L118@P5: (3) Impedance meter
L119@P5: The impedance meter with AC 1kHz should be used.
L120@P5: 7. Characteristics
L121@P5: 7.1 Standard Charge
L122@P5: This "Standard Charge" means charging the cell with charge current of 0.5C
L123@P5: (2,450mA) and constant voltage 4.2V and 0.02C(98mA) cut-off in CV mode at 23°C.
L124@P5: 7.2 Standard Discharge Capacity
L125@P5: The standard discharge capacity is the initial discharge capacity of the cell, which is
L126@P5: measured with discharge current of 0.2C(980mA) with 2.50V cut-off at 23°C
L127@P5: within 1 hour after the Standard charge.
L128@P5: Standard Discharge Capacity ≥ 4,900mAh
L129@P5: 7.3 Rated Discharge Capacity
L130@P5: The rated discharge capacity is the initial discharge capacity of the cell, which is
L131@P5: measured with discharge current of 1C(4,900mA) with 2.50V cut-off at 23°C
L132@P5: within 1 hour after the Standard charge.
L133@P5: Rated Discharge Capacity ≥ 4,753mAh (97% of 4,900mAh)
L134@P5: 7.4 Initial internal impedance
L135@P5: Initial internal impedance measured at AC 1kHz after Standard charge.
L136@P5-6: Initial internal impedance ≤ 35mΩSAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary
L137@P6: 6

L141@P6: constant current 1C(4,900mA) and 2.50V cut-off with follow temperature after the
L142@P6: standard charging at 23°C.

L159@P6: Each cycle is an interval between the charge (charge current 2,450mA) with

L161@P6: cut-off. Capacity after 500cycles.

L163@P6: 7.9 Recovery Characteristics
L164@P6: Capacity after storage for 30days at 60°C after the Standard charged at 23°C,
L165@P6: measured with discharge current 4,900mA with 2.50V cut-off at 23℃.
L166@P6: Capacity recovery(after the storage) ≥ 4,278mAh (90% of Rated Capacity)
L167@P6: 7.10 Status of the cell as of ex-factory
L168@P6-7: The cell should be shipped in 3.43V ~ 3.63V Charging voltage range.SAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary
L169@P7: 7
L170@P7: Spec. No. INR21700-50E Version No. 0.2
L171@P7: 8. Mechanical Characteristics
L172@P7: 8.1 Drop Test
L173@P7: Test method: Each fully charged cell or battery is dropped three times from a height of
L174@P7: 1.0 m onto a concrete floor. The cells or batteries are dropped so as to
L175@P7: obtain impacts in random orientations. After the test, the sample shall be
L176@P7: put on rest for a minimum of one hour and then a visual inspection shall
L177@P7: be performed.
L178@P7: Criteria: No fire, no explosion
L179@P7: Drop test shall be performed with the IEC 62133
L180@P7: 8.2 Vibration Test
L181@P7: Test method: As to the UN transportation regulation(UN38.3), for each axis (X and Y
L182@P7: axis with cylindrical cells) 7Hz→200Hz→7Hz for 15min,
L183@P7: repetition 12 times totally 3hours, the acceleration 1g during 7 to 18Hz
L184@P7: and 8g (amplitude 1.6mm) up to 200Hz.
L185@P7: Criteria: No leakage, with less than 10mV of OCV drop
L186@P7: Vibration test shall be performed with the UN38.3 standard
L187@P7: 9. Safety
L188@P7: 9.1 Overcharge test
L189@P7: Test method: To charge the standard charged cell with 4.2V and 3C (7,35A) at 23°C
L190@P7: for 7 hours
L191@P7: Criteria: No fire, and no explosion.
L192@P7: Overcharge test shall be performed with the UL1642 standard
L193@P7: 9.2 External short-circuit test
L194@P7: Test method: Fully rated charged cell is to be short-circuited by connecting the positive
L195@P7: and negative terminals of the battery with a circuit load having a
L196@P7: resistance load of 80 ±20 mΩ. The battery is to discharge until a fire or
L197@P7: explosion is obtained, or until it has reached a completely discharged
L198@P7: state of less than 0.2 V and the battery case temperature has returned to
L199@P7: ±10°C of ambient temperature. The return to near ambient of the battery
L200@P7: (cell) casing in an indication of ultimate results.
L201@P7: Tests are to be conducted at 20 ±5°C and at 55 ±5°C.
L202@P7: Criteria: No fire, and no explosion.
L203@P7: External short-circuit test shall be performed with the UL1642 standard
L204@P7: 9.3 Forced discharge test
L205@P7: Test method: A discharged cell is subjected to a reverse charge at 1.0C(4,900mA)
L206@P7: for 90 min.
L207@P7-8: Criteria: No fire, and no explosion.SAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary
L208@P8: 8
L209@P8: Spec. No. INR21700-50E Version No. 0.2
L210@P8: Forced discharge test shall be performed with the IEC62133 standard
L211@P8: 9.4 Heating test
L212@P8: Test method: To heat up the standard charged cell at heating rate 5℃ per minute
L213@P8: up to 130℃ and keep the cell in oven for 30 min.
L214@P8: Criteria: No fire, and no explosion.
L215@P8: Heating test shall be performed with the UL1642 standard(10 min) & GB31241
L216@P8: standard(30 min).
L217@P8: 10. Warranty
L218@P8: Samsung SDI will be responsible for replacing the cell against defects or poor workmanship
L219@P8: for 15 months from the date of shipping. Any other problems caused by malfunction of the
L220@P8: equipment or unsuitable use of the cell are not under this warranty.
L221@P8: The warranty set forth in proper use, handling conditions described above,
L222@P8: and excludes in the case of a defect which is not related to manufacturing of the cell.
L223@P8: 11. Others
L224@P8: 11.1 Storage for a long time
L225@P8: If the cell is kept for a long time (3months or more), It is strongly recommended
L226@P8: that the cell is preserved at dry and low-temperature.
L227@P8: 11.2 Other
L228@P8: Any matters that specifications does not have, should be conferred with
L229@P8-9: between the both parties.SAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary

L244@P12: Spec. No. INR21700-50E Version No. 0.2
L245@P12: Proper Use and Handling of Lithium Ion Cells
L246@P12: See before using lithium-ion cell
L247@P12: This document has been prepared to describe the appropriate cautions and prohibitions,
L248@P12: which the customer should take or employ when the customer uses and handles the lithium
L249@P12: ion cell to be manufactured and supplied by Samsung SDI Co., Ltd., in order to obtain
L250@P12: optimum performance and safety.
L251@P12: 1. Charging
L252@P12: 1.1 Charging current
L253@P12: Charging current should be less than maximum charge current specified in the product
L254@P12: specification.
L255@P12: 1.2 Charging voltage
L256@P12: Charging should be done by voltage less than that specified in the product
L257@P12: specification.
L258@P12: 1.3 Charging time
L259@P12: Continuous charging under specified voltage does not cause any loss of performance
L260@P12: characteristics. However, the charge timer is recommended to be installed from a
L261@P12: safety consideration, which shuts off further charging at time specified in the product
L262@P12: specification.
L263@P12: 1.4 Charging temperature
L264@P12: The cell should be charged within a range of specified temperatures in the
L265@P12: specification.
L266@P12: 1.5 Reverse charging
L267@P12: The cell should be connected, confirming that its poles are correctly aligned.
L268@P12: Inverse charging should be strictly prohibited. If the cell is connected improperly, it
L269@P12: may be damaged.
L270@P12: 2. Discharging
L271@P12: 2.1 Discharging
L272@P12: The cell shall be discharged continuously at less than maximum discharge current
L273@P12: specified in the product specification. In case of the higher discharge current should be
L274@P12: set, it shall be discussed together with SDI.
L275@P12: 2.2 Discharging temperature
L276@P12: 2.2.1 The cell should be discharged within a range of temperatures specified in the
L277@P12: product specification.
L278@P12-13: 2.2.2 Otherwise, it may cause loss of characteristics.SAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary
L279@P13: 13
L280@P13: Spec. No. INR21700-50E Version No. 0.2
L281@P13: 2.3 Over-discharging
L282@P13: 2.3.1 The system should be equipped with a device to prevent further discharging
L283@P13: exceeding discharging cut-off voltage specified in the product specification.
L284@P13: 2.3.2 Over-discharging may cause loss of performance, characteristics of battery
L285@P13: function.
L286@P13: 2.3.3 Over-discharging may occur by self-discharge if the battery is left for a very long
L287@P13: time without any use.
L288@P13: 2.3.4 The charger should be equipped with a device to detect cell voltage and to
L289@P13: determine recharging procedures.
L290@P13: 3. Storage
L291@P13: 3.1 Storage conditions
L292@P13: 3.1.1 The cell should be stored within a range of temperatures specified in the product
L293@P13: specification.
L294@P13: 3.1.2 Otherwise, it may cause loss of performance characteristics, leakage and/or rust.
L295@P13: 3.2 Long-term storage
L296@P13: 3.2.1 The cell should be used within a short period after charging because long-term
L297@P13: storage may cause loss of capacity by self-discharging.
L298@P13: 3.2.2 If long-term storage is necessary, the cell should be stored at lower voltage
L299@P13: within a range specified in the product specification, because storage with higher
L300@P13: voltage may cause more loss of performance characteristics.
L301@P13: 3.2.3 Store the battery at 0 ~ 23℃, low humidity (below 65%), no dust and no
L302@P13: corrosive gas atmosphere.
L303@P13: 4. Cycle life
L304@P13: 4.1 Cycle life performance
L305@P13: 4.1.1 The cell can be charged/discharged repeatedly up to times specified in the
L306@P13: produce specification with a certain level of capacity also specified in the product
L307@P13: specification.
L308@P13: 4.1.2 Cycle life may be determined by conditions of charging, discharging, operating
L309@P13: temperature and/or storage.
L310@P13: 5. Battery Pack Assembly
L311@P13: 5.1 Prohibition of usage of damaged cell
L312@P13: 5.1.1 The cell should be inspected visually before battery assembly.
L313@P13: 5.1.2 The cell should not be used if sleeve-damage, can-distortion and/or
L314@P13-14: electrolyte-smell is detected.SAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary
L315@P14: 14
L316@P14: Spec. No. INR21700-50E Version No. 0.2
L317@P14: 5.2 Terminals handling
L318@P14: 5.2.1 Excessive force on the negative terminal should be avoided when external strip
L319@P14: terminal is welled.
L320@P14: 5.3 Transportation
L321@P14: 5.3.1 If the cell is necessary to be transported to such as the battery manufacturer,
L322@P14: careful precautions should be taken to avoid damage of cell.
L323@P14: 6. Others
L324@P14: 6.1 Disassembly
L325@P14: 6.1.1 The cell should not be dismantled from the battery pack.
L326@P14: 6.1.2 Internal short-circuit caused by disassembly may lead to heat generation and/or
L327@P14: venting.
L328@P14: 6.1.3 When the electrolyte is coming in contact with the skin or eyes, wash
L329@P14: immediately with fresh water and seek medical advice.
L330@P14: 6.2 Short-circuiting
L331@P14: 6.2.1 Short-circuit results in very high current which leads to heat generation.
L332@P14: 6.2.2 An appropriate circuitry should be employed to protect accidental short-circuiting.
L333@P14: 6.3 Incineration
L334@P14: 6.3.1 Incinerating and disposing of the cell in fire are strictly prohibited, because it may
L335@P14: cause rupture and explosion.
L336@P14: 6.4 Immersion
L337@P14: 6.4.1 Soaking the cell in water is strictly prohibited, because it may cause corrosion and
L338@P14: leakage of components to be damaged to functions.
L339@P14: 6.5 Mixing use
L340@P14: 6.5.1 Different types of cell, or same types but different cell manufacturer's shall not
L341@P14: be used, which may lead to cell imbalance, cell rupture or damage to system due
L342@P14: to the different characteristics of cell.
L343@P14: 6.5.2 Do not mix use the cells from different batches/ranks even they are the same cell
L344@P14: types from the same manufacturer.
L345@P14: 6.6 Battery disposal
L346@P14: 6.6.1 Although the cell contains no environmentally hazardous component, such as
L347@P14: lead or cadmium. the battery should be disposed according to the local
L348@P14: regulations when it is disposed.
L349@P14: 6.6.2 The cell should be disposed with a discharged state to avoid heat generation by
L350@P14-15: an inadvertent short-circuit.SAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary
L351@P15: 15
L352@P15: Spec. No. INR21700-50E Version No. 0.2
L353@P15: 6.7 Caution
L354@P15: 6.7.1 The Battery used in this device may present a risk of fire or chemical burn if
L355@P15: mistreated.
L356@P15: 6.7.2 Do not disassemble, expose to heat above 100℃ or incinerate it.
L357@P15: 6.7.3 Replace battery with Samsung SDI battery only.
L358@P15: 6.7.4 Use of another battery may present a risk of fire or explosion.
L359@P15: 6.7.5 Dispose of used battery promptly.
L360@P15: 6.7.6 Keep away from children.
L361@P15-16: 6.7.7 Do not disassemble and do not dispose of in fire.SAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary
L362@P16: 16
L363@P16: Spec. No. INR21700-50E Version No. 0.2
L364@P16: Pack Design Guideline for Lithium Ion Cells
L365@P16: If a customer’s battery pack cannot meet Pack Design Guideline,
L366@P16: SDI cannot take responsibility for a quality issue about a battery cell.
L367@P16: 1. Electrical design
L368@P16: 1.1 Charge
L369@P16: 1.1.1 Stop charging the battery if charging isn't completed within the specified time.
L370@P16: 1.1.2 The battery can be used within the following temperature ranges.
L371@P16: Don't exceed these ranges.
L372@P16: Charge temperature ranges : 0℃ ~ 45℃
L373@P16: 1.1.3 Charge current must be controlled by specified value in Cell specification.
L374@P16: 1.1.4 Cut-off Voltage of charging must be under 4.2V.
L375@P16: 1.1.5 Charger must stop charging battery by detecting either charging time or current
L376@P16: specified in Cell’s specification.
L377@P16: 1.1.6 Recharge Voltage must be at least 0.1V lower than Max charging Voltage.
L378@P16: 1.1.7 Do not charge the battery under 1.0V voltage.
L379@P16: 1.1.8 Voltage range of the battery for pre-charge mode is 1.0 ~ 3.0V with a charging
L380@P16: current of 0.1 ~ 0.5C
L381@P16: 1.2 Discharge
L382@P16: 1.2.1 Discharge current must be controlled by specified value in Cell’s specification.
L383@P16: 1.2.2 Cut-off Voltage of discharging must be over 2.5V.
L384@P16: 1.2.3 The battery can be used within the following temperature ranges.
L385@P16: Don't exceed these ranges.
L386@P16: Discharge temperature ranges : -20℃ ~ 60℃
L387@P16: 1.3 Storage
L388@P16: Store the battery at low temperature (below 60℃, 20℃ is recommended), low
L389@P16: humidity(below 65%), no dust and no corrosive gas atmosphere.
L390@P16: 1.4 Design of positioning the battery pack in application and charger
L391@P16: To prevent the deterioration of the battery performance caused by heat, battery shall
L392@P16: be positioned away from the area where heat is generated in the application and the
L393@P16: charger.
L394@P16: 1.5 Safety Device
L395@P16: Be sure adopting proper safe device such as PTC specified type or model in Cell
L396@P16: Specification. If you intend to adopt different safety device which is not specified in Cell
L397@P16: Specification, please contact Samsung SDI to investigate any potential safety problem.
L398@P16: Be sure designing 2nd protective devices such as PTC & PCM at the same time to
L399@P16-17: protect Cell just in case one protective device is fault.SAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary
L400@P17: 17
L401@P17: Spec. No. INR21700-50E Version No. 0.2
L402@P17: 2. Design of System
L403@P17: 2.1 Connection between the cell and the battery
L404@P17: 2.1.1 The cell should not be soldered directly with other cells. Namely, the cell should
L405@P17: be welded with leads on its terminal and then be soldered with wire or leads to
L406@P17: solder.
L407@P17: 2.1.2 Otherwise, it may cause damage of component, such as separator and insulator,
L408@P17: by heat generation.
L409@P17: 2.2 Positioning the battery in the System
L410@P17: 2.2.1 The battery should be positioned as possible as far from heat sources and high
L411@P17: temperature components.
L412@P17: 2.2.2 Otherwise, it may cause loss of characteristics.
L413@P17: 2.2.3 The recommended spacing between the cells is more than 1mm.
L414@P17: 2.3 Mechanical shock protection of the battery
L415@P17: 2.3.1 The battery should be equipped with appropriate shock absorbers in the pack in
L416@P17: order to minimize shock, which can damage the cells. .
L417@P17: 2.3.2 Otherwise, it may cause shape distortion, leakage, heat generation and/or
L418@P17: rupture and/or open circuit.
L419@P17: 2.3.3 Ultrasonic should not be used when manufacturing battery packs as it can
L420@P17: damage the connection between component parts.
L421@P17: 2.4 Short-circuit protection of the cell
L422@P17: 2.4.1 The cell is equipped with an insulating sleeve to protect short-circuit which may
L423@P17: occur during transportation, battery assembly and /or system operation.
L424@P17: 2.4.2 If the cell sleeve is damaged by some causes such as outside impact, it may
L425@P17: cause short-circuit with some wiring inside the battery.
